searchText: Geth devs: In some logs from Besu I saw that geth is sometimes only responding with one header when I'm requesting 200 block headers with a skip. Why would that happen? if we're going to go with this more general approach, it might make sense to separate exits and partial withdrawals so that they each have an independent fee market I believe the simplification is only on the block structure side. Having 7002 queue split into two is an orthogonal thing, but the Requests proposal makes the split less complicated
